welcome.title: Your land has a plan.
welcome.purpose: Explore rotations for your field, with the evidence and its limits.
welcome.line1: Rotavise reads NASA satellite data for your field.
welcome.line2: It compares your rotation with at least two others.
welcome.line3: It tells you how sure it is and what to check locally.
welcome.availability: The interface is being built. The existing planner remains available; the map and multi-year comparison arrive in later steps.

create.title: Select fields
create.tapHint: Zoom in, then tap your field.
create.zoomHint: Zoom in to your field to paint 30 m cells.
create.paintHint: Drag to add or remove cells. Hold Alt to pan the map.
create.drawHint: Tap the corners, then the first point to close the outline. Drag points to adjust.
create.uploadHint: GeoJSON, KML or zipped shapefile with its projection (.prj). Polygons only. File limit 10 MB; KML 1 MB.
create.pinHint: Tap the map to place a pin without an outline.
create.paintKeyboard: Keyboard: arrows move the cell, Space toggles it. Use two fingers to pan.
create.drawKeyboard: Keyboard: arrows pan, Enter adds a point at the centre, Shift + Enter closes. Backspace removes the last point.
create.pinKeyboard: Keyboard: arrows pan, Enter selects the centre.
create.snapOff: No visible suggested edges to snap to.
create.suggestionLimits: Suggested outlines, accuracy unmeasured. They may merge, split or miss fields. These are not legal parcel boundaries. Published confidence refers to a 500 m area.
create.ftwCredit: Outlines: Fields of The World (Robinson et al., 2026), CC BY 4.0
create.name: Field name
create.nameError: Use 1 to 80 characters without control characters.
create.filled: Small holes were filled. Check the outline.
create.narrow: This area is narrower than a usable NASA pixel.
create.pinLimit: Add an outline to ask NASA for this field’s data. Comparisons can use its location.
create.historyError: Choose a crop and both dates, with planting before harvest.
create.alreadySaved: Field saved. It will not be created again.
create.offline: Offline: your selections stay here. Reconnect to save.
create.conflict: These details changed elsewhere. Check saved fields before trying again.
create.uncertain: The response was interrupted. The field may have been saved. Check the list before starting again.
create.disconnected: Connect the cells into one field.
create.hole: A hole is at least 1 ha. Paint it or adjust the outline.
create.complex: Outline too complex. Simplify it while keeping its shape, or import a smaller file.
create.invalid: Outline not accepted. Check the format, projection and closed rings.
create.large: Outline spans too far. Draw a smaller area.
create.area: Area must be between 0.1 and 1,000 ha.
create.crossing: The outline crosses itself or repeats a vertex. Adjust the points.
create.worker: Outline processing was interrupted. Close and reopen this panel.
create.noCoverage: There are no suggested outlines in this view. You can paint or draw your field.
create.noField: No suggested outline here. Choose Paint or Draw.
create.moreProblems: More polygons were also rejected. Check the file.

f4.deleteFieldBody: This deletes the field, its crop history and NASA data requests. Comparisons made from it stay.
f4.offline: Saved information is read-only while you are offline.
f4.conflict: This was changed elsewhere. We loaded the latest version. You can reapply your edit.
f4.conflictGone: The entry you edited has changed or is gone. Close this form to see the latest information.
f4.nameInvalid: Enter a field name from 1 to 80 characters.
f4.builderUnavailable: New comparisons are unavailable from this panel.
f4.resultsUnavailable: The full comparison is unavailable from this panel.
f4.noPlans: This field has no saved comparisons.
f4.outlineHelp: Draw on the map or move the outline points. Keep the saved field location inside the outline.
f4.mapNeeded: The outline editor needs the map to be available.
f4.outlineContains: The outline must contain the saved field location.
history.deleteBody: This removes the crop and dates for this season from the field history.
history.empty: Add the crops you grew here. You can enter approximate dates from memory.
history.varietyHelp: A variety can be saved in a comparison. Field history saves the crop and dates.
history.invalid: Choose a crop and valid planting and harvest dates. Planting must be on or before harvest.
history.overlap: These dates overlap another season on this field.
inputs.removeSoilBody: Save to remove this measurement from the field.
inputs.soilHelp: A laboratory test gives a local measurement. A comparison can use a SoilGrids estimate at about 250 m when measurements are missing.
inputs.invalidSoil: Check the value, method and date for this measurement.
inputs.allocationHelp: A water allocation can be entered for a comparison. This field records availability.
inputs.removeHealthBody: Save to remove this report from the field.
inputs.healthHelp: These reports record observations. Ask a local specialist for a diagnosis.
inputs.farmerCannotConfirm: A farmer report cannot be a confirmed diagnosis.
inputs.invalidHealth: Choose a crop and enter a valid problem, date and reporter.
inputs.duplicateHealth: This report is already recorded for the field.
inputs.estimateLater: Available after the first completed comparison that used SoilGrids.
inputs.estimateHelp: This estimate describes the grid cell. A soil test measures your field directly.

crops.effect.residual_nitrogen_credit: Nitrogen left for the next crop
nasa.title: NASA data
nasa.limit: Up to ten new requests a day for observations and ten for extractions.
nasa.waitHelp: NASA processing can take hours. You can leave this page while the request runs.
nasa.outline: Add an outline to request these data.
nasa.smapHelp: This is a regional measurement. Some days have no percentile.
nasa.erosionGap: An erosion estimate also needs rainfall energy, soil erodibility, crop cover and farming practices. Infiltration and drainage are unknown.
nasa.ecostressHelp: Clear satellite passes can be infrequent. The dataset records only scenes that passed its quality checks.
nasa.scenes: {count, plural, one {# satellite scene} other {# satellite scenes}}
nasa.graceHelp: The trend describes the region. A well reading measures local conditions.
nasa.gediHelp: GEDI provides context on nearby trees and shrubs. Crop biomass requires separate measurements.
nasa.fieldCell: Biomass in the field’s grid cell
nasa.cells: {count, plural, one {# grid cell} other {# grid cells}}
nasa.trendUnreported: No trend reported for this series.
nasa.lowHelp: Low greenness can mean bare soil or stubble. Check what was on the field.
